<style id="pearistic-side-page-and-panel-fix">
/* PearisticOS 17/27: side-page Dock clearance and intrinsic panel sizing.
   The Dock should reserve space only on ordinary Home pages. */
#home.side-page-active .home-area,
#home.side-page-active #homeArea,
#home.side-page-active.desktop .home-area {
  bottom: 0 !important;
  min-height: 0;
}
#home.side-page-active .dock,
#home.side-page-active #dock,
#home.side-page-active .page-dots {
  visibility: hidden !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}
#home.side-page-active .app-library-page,
#home.side-page-active .notification-page {
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior-y: contain;
  padding-bottom: max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) !important;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
#home.side-page-active .notifications-only-stack {
  max-height: none;
  overflow: visible;
  padding-bottom: 24px;
}
#controlOverlay .control-panel,
#notificationsOverlay .notifications-panel {
  bottom: auto !important;
  height: max-content !important;
  max-height: calc(100dvh - max(58px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) - 18px) !important;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto !important;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}
#controlOverlay .control-panel {
  top: max(58px, calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-top))) !important;
}
#notificationsOverlay .notifications-panel {
  top: max(58px, calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-top))) !important;
}
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  #controlOverlay .control-panel,
  #notificationsOverlay .notifications-panel {
    top: auto !important;
    bottom: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) !important;
    max-height: calc(100dvh - max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) - max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) - 12px) !important;
  }
}
</style>

<script>
/* PearisticOS: native fullscreen requested on first real interaction. Browsers
   prohibit fullscreen on page load, so first pointer/key interaction is required.
   Settings is the only permanent on-screen fullscreen control. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  let automaticAttempted=false;
  const settingButton=()=>document.getElementById('pearFullscreenSettingsButton');
  function refreshFullscreenControl(){
    const button=settingButton();if(!button)return;
    const active=Boolean(document.fullscreenElement);
    button.textContent=active?'Exit fullscreen':'Enter fullscreen';
    button.setAttribute('aria-label',button.textContent);
  }
  function notifyFullscreenError(){
    const toast=document.getElementById('toast');
    if(toast){toast.textContent='Browser fullscreen unavailable. Try F11 or install as an app.';toast.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),3500)}
  }
  async function setFullscreen(enabled,automatic=false){
    try{
      if(enabled && !document.fullscreenElement){
        if(typeof document.documentElement.requestFullscreen!=='function')throw new Error('Fullscreen API unavailable');
        await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen({navigationUI:'hide'});
      }else if(!enabled && document.fullscreenElement){
        await document.exitFullscreen();
      }
    }catch(error){if(!automatic)notifyFullscreenError()}
    refreshFullscreenControl();
  }
  window.pearToggleFullscreen=()=>setFullscreen(!Boolean(document.fullscreenElement));
  const autoStart=(event)=>{
    if(automaticAttempted || event.isTrusted===false)return;
    if(event.type==='pointerdown' && (event.button!==0 || event.isPrimary===false))return;
    if(event.type==='keydown' && (event.ctrlKey||event.altKey||event.metaKey||['Shift','Control','Alt','Meta','Escape','Tab'].includes(event.key)))return;
    automaticAttempted=true; // Deliberately do not re-enter after Esc/Settings.
    document.removeEventListener('pointerdown',autoStart,true);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown',autoStart,true);
    void setFullscreen(true,true);
  };
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',autoStart,{capture:true,passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',autoStart,true);
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',refreshFullscreenControl);
  // Fullscreen button is no longer floating on the Home Screen.
  refreshFullscreenControl();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* Dock uses a single pixel size for the shelf and each icon.
   ResizeObserver handles windowed/fullscreen changes, MutationObserver handles
   edit-mode Dock additions and removals without changing their behavior. */
(() => {
  const dock = document.getElementById('dock');
  const home = document.getElementById('home');
  if (!dock || !home) return;
  let scheduled = false;
  function resizeDock() {
    scheduled = false;
    const count = dock.querySelectorAll(':scope > .app-icon').length;
    const hostWidth = home.clientWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
    const desktop = home.classList.contains('desktop');
    const available = Math.max(80, Math.min(desktop ? 900 : 980, hostWidth - (hostWidth < 600 ? 18 : 28)));
    const paddingX = hostWidth < 440 ? 10 : 14;
    const paddingY = hostWidth < 440 ? 10 : 13;
    const gap = hostWidth < 440 ? 6 : 9;
    const normalSize = desktop ? 86 : hostWidth < 440 ? 78 : hostWidth < 700 ? 84 : 100;
    const inner = Math.max(1, available - paddingX * 2 - 2 - Math.max(0, count - 1) * gap);
    const iconSize = Math.max(42, Math.min(normalSize, count ? inner / count : normalSize));
    const shelfWidth = Math.min(available, Math.ceil(count * iconSize + Math.max(0, count - 1) * gap + paddingX * 2 + 2));
    const shelfHeight = Math.ceil(iconSize + paddingY * 2 + 2);
    dock.style.setProperty('--pear-dock-width', `${shelfWidth}px`);
    dock.style.setProperty('--pear-dock-icon', `${iconSize}px`);
    dock.style.setProperty('--pear-dock-height', `${shelfHeight}px`);
    dock.style.setProperty('--pear-dock-gap', `${gap}px`);
    dock.style.setProperty('--pear-dock-pad-x', `${paddingX}px`);
    dock.style.setProperty('--pear-dock-pad-y', `${paddingY}px`);
  }
  function scheduleResize() {
    if (scheduled) return;
    scheduled = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(resizeDock);
  }
  new MutationObserver(scheduleResize).observe(dock, { childList: true });
  new MutationObserver(scheduleResize).observe(home, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') new ResizeObserver(scheduleResize).observe(home);
  window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleResize, {passive: true});
  window.visualViewport?.addEventListener('resize', scheduleResize, {passive: true});
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', scheduleResize);
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', scheduleResize);
  scheduleResize();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* Explicitly settle the final layout when browser fullscreen UI or mobile
   visual viewport reports its new size asynchronously. */
(() => {
  const area=document.getElementById('homeArea');
  if(!area || typeof window.__pearUpdateGrid!=='function')return;
  let frame=0;
  function update(){cancelAnimationFrame(frame);frame=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
    window.__pearUpdateGrid();
  });}
  if(typeof ResizeObserver!=='undefined')new ResizeObserver(update).observe(area);
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',()=>{
    update();requestAnimationFrame(update);
    setTimeout(update,100);
    setTimeout(update,300);
  });
  window.visualViewport?.addEventListener('resize',update,{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange',update,{passive:true});
  update();
})();
</script>
